tests.name: Independent numeric and concurrent gamma audit

bounds: Current managed calibration and integration checks use generated pixels, injected clock/transport and isolated settings. Independent numeric/concurrent checks are separate arithmetic validation, not additional engine cases. Native DLL and shader are byte-identical to v0.1.3 and were not rebuilt; nine generated WARP red-color comparisons were run during diagnosis. Previous release tests and physical off/resume evidence are historical, not rerun or new physical acceptance. No exact display/strip color match or long-duration stability is established.
changes: Adds optional output gamma calibration (default 100 percent, 1.0 neutral) and Favor vivid colors (default off). Vivid preference reduces pale pixels influence in mixed areas using bounded squared-chroma weighting, preserving uniform colors, original dark-background support/fade, and the original maximum encoded channel ceiling. A cached immutable 256-entry gamma lookup then transforms zone RGB before temporal smoothing. Legacy defaults/overloads preserve exact bytes. UI and local settings persist both controls. Higher gamma deepens midtones and reduces small RGB components, also dimming midtone whites. HDR/capture/area detection and pause/off/exit behavior are unchanged. No extra worker, capture pass or service. Also fixes the dark-background test runner hash-file self-lock.

previousReleaseValidation.bounds: 179 managed cases/groups passed using injected native results, clock and network plus isolated recovery processes. Native C++/D3D11 WARP ran 26 top-level checks: ten encoding/cache checks, one aggregate of twenty existing controls, and fifteen masked-image checks. These generated fixtures do not capture protected video or establish physical lighting acceptance. Previous owner-confirmed lock/off/resume and automatic display-off/resume remain historical evidence. No full system-sleep or long-duration physical acceptance for this build.
